mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS membershipId, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, m.term_no AS termNo, m.former_role_code AS formerRoleCode, m.status, m.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM membership m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = m.role_id WHERE m.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY m.status ASC, m.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS clubId, c.name AS clubName, c.description AS clubDescription, tu.nickname AS teacherName, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, m.status, m.term_no AS termNo, m.former_role_code AS formerRoleCode FROM membership m JOIN club c ON c.id = m.club_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = c.teacher_id AND tu.deleted = 0 JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = m.role_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS clubId, c.name AS clubName, c.description AS clubDescription, tu.nickname AS teacherName, 'teacher' AS roleCode, '指导老师' AS roleName, 1 AS status FROM club c JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = c.teacher_id AND tu.deleted = 0 WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS clubId, c.name AS clubName, m.id AS membershipId, u.username, u.nickname, m.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM membership m JOIN club c ON c.id = m.club_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE m.status = 0 AND c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY m.applied_at ASC

SELECT c.id AS clubId, c.name AS clubName, m.id AS membershipId, u.username, u.nickname, m.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM membership m JOIN club c ON c.id = m.club_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE m.status = 0 AND m.club_id IN ( SELECT me.club_id FROM membership me JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = me.role_id WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.status = 1 AND r.is_management = TRUE ) ORDER BY m.applied_at ASC

SELECT m.user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS nickname, r.code AS roleCode FROM membership m JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = m.role_id AND r.is_management = TRUE JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = m.user_id WHERE m.club_id = #{clubId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC
